items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-05-28
items.q: His wife was Constance and their daughter was Mion. And they, they exposed me to that side.

ctx.x: And so I was exposed to that and he was a real Frenchman, I mean, you know. His wife was Constance and their daughter was Mion. And they, they exposed me to that side.
Uh-huh. Right. Both of my grandmothers spoke French. But that was that generation. Yeah. And it was the last generation that did that.
